name: Antinuous
long_description:
Antinuous is building autonomous research agents to help people in research, development, discovery, and knowledge work do faster, more accurate research end to end without a human in the loop.

We believe humans should be able to ask a single question, and no matter how simple or complex, agents should look at the question, break it down, research the answer, test new ideas, simulate new environments, and repeat autonomously using as much or little compute as necessary elastically.
one_liner: Autonomous research agents for R&D and education

question_answers.question: How did your company get started? (i.e., How did the founders meet? How did you come up with the idea? How did you decide to be a founder?)
question_answers.answer:
We started as Salesgraph, building agents and workflows for enterprise sales teams.

In enterprise sales, there are four bottlenecks: pipeline, execution, internal, and implementation

Pipeline: how can I do effective outreach to more people.

Execution: how can I boost deal win rate.

Internal: how can I make CPQ, deal-desk, approvals, and negotiations fast.

Implementation: how can I get new customers onboarded smoothly post-sale to avoid clawback.

We were working on execution first, because we solved that internally at Mintlify. After we started tackling pipeline generation, we realized that pipeline generation tools make great primitives for all research.

To build pipeline, you need to create tables of people and companies that you want to sell into. From those tables, you create primitives to dive deeper and do more specialized research to then build automations off of.

What if you want to do deeper research? Learn the industry that your pipeline is built on, map vertical bottlenecks to your solution, go deep on each person to see how they relate to you? Now, you’re going the extra mile to partner on a solution to a business problem with each client, not just features.

But what if you expand this past sales?

What if you’re in manufacturing and want to map supply chain bottlenecks to do better capacity planning?

What if you’re in finance and want to see what data-center construction is doing to grid prices in Texas and Louisiana?

What if you’re in R&D at a biotech and want to run virtual simulations overnight without hooking it up to your lab equipment.

This tool that we built for a niche use case of account research and pipeline generation turns out to be the perfect primitive for all research.

What if we built the best tools for agents to be able to run simulations, experiments, and research in collaboration autonomously.

We can then build the most intuitive way to give humans info from that research in a way they can digest and build a better flywheel.

We quickly went from asking how good can we make sales outreach more effective to asking how many people we can reach who have a question they can’t answer because they don’t have the tools or knowhow.

From building the tools to close revenue more effectively, we realized there's a much larger opportunity to build better tools for agents to answer any question.

As Antinuous, we are building an autonomous research platform where people can investigate their hardest questions and turn what they learn into action.

launches.title: Salesgraph - your marketers, analysts, & strategists, working 24/7 on every deal.
launches.tagline: Automate context gathering, collateral, and strategy for enterprise sales teams
launches.body:
Hey we’re [Ruhan](https://www.linkedin.com/in/ruhanponnada/) and [Ricardo](https://www.linkedin.com/in/ricardonunez-01/) - engineer turned seller, and seller turned engineer.

**Offer:** Get a free [GTM Audit ](https://www.salesgraph.com/gtm-audit)on your company or prospects + if you intro us to a closer, for a meeting booked, get free Lulu merch!\
\
**TL;DR** Salesgraph automates deal context and collateral for enterprise sales teams, so every rep walks into every call prepared and leaves every call with clear next steps. We're a headless UI, starting with a Slack-native experience that integrates with your CRM, calendar, call recordings, docs, blogs, case studies, and research.

<https://youtu.be/fO6c2wIPwIw>
\
**The Problem:**
Sales reps have too much on their plate: back-to-back meetings, Slack messages from prospects, follow-up emails, and coordination with SEs. The best reps balance this. The rest forget to follow up, come to calls unprepared, and lose deals at pricing because they can't value sell.\
\
This gets harder when you're selling a technical product as a non-technical rep. You can't articulate value if you don't fully understand what you're selling, so reps default to features, line items, and discounts.\
\
**The Result:** enterprise deals die in procurement. \
\
When reps walk in without a clear business case, procurement has all the leverage. Deals stall on price, ACV gets discounted away, or the deal dies entirely.

We lived this at Mintlify. Reps looked great on paper, but folded under pressure. The truth is, sales is as much nurturing as it is selling. The best reps act like consultants, not order takers.\
\
**Our Solution:** At an internal Mintlify hackathon, our Head of Sales paired with Ricardo to build an internal tool: a value case generator trained on call recordings, past deals, case studies, ROI calculators, and the MEDDIC framework. The output was a 3-page business case our champions used to sell Mintlify internally — driving higher ACVs and helping us close millions from enterprise logos.

Why can’t we evangelize every GTM team to close deals at higher ACV through encouraging value selling? \
\
We took those learnings to build Salesgraph.

In Slack, reps get proactive context 5 minutes before every call — triggers from background agents, key notes from previous calls, and what to cover next. After every call, they get a DM with strengths, gaps to address, and next steps.

We integrate with major call recorders and ship our own ambient recorder (a sales-focused alternative to Granola), **free for founders and teams under 3**.\
\
**Why this matters for everyone, not just reps:**

* **Sales managers** query deal state directly in Slack, no more reading low-quality opp notes or meaningless health scores
* **SEs and FDEs** stop watching call recordings at 2x speed; they just ask in Slack
* **Customer success** sees what was actually promised vs delivered

\
Every rep should sell like your best rep. \
\
Try us out <https://www.salesgraph.com/>.
